entry.title: Upcoming deprecation of GPT-5.2 and GPT-5.2-Codex
entry.summary: We will deprecate GPT-5.2 and GPT-5.2-Codex across GitHub Copilot experiences on June 1, 2026, and teams need to move workflows to supported models before the cutoff.

entry.title: Copilot Student GPT-5.3-Codex removal from model picker
entry.summary: GitHub removed GPT-5.3-Codex from the Copilot Student model picker, while keeping it available through auto model selection.

entry.title: GitHub Copilot code review will start consuming GitHub Actions minutes on June 1, 2026
entry.summary: Starting June 1, 2026, each Copilot code review will consume GitHub Actions minutes, so engineering teams need to plan for a billing and workflow impact.
